title_en: A bus from Bangkok to Nakhon Pathom has lost its course and crashed into a roadside. One person died, one was seriously injured and more than 30 people were wounded.
summary_en: Bangkok-Nakhon Phanom bus main line crashed down the side of the road at Korat Thap. 1 dead, 1 seriously injured, 39 slightly injured. On October 18, 2026, the accident center was notified of the accident. The Bangkok-Sakon Nakhon-Nakhon Phanom white air-conditioned bus picked up both Thai and foreign passengers from Nakhon Phanom and Sakon Nakhon provinces. 41 people headed into the city.
